name: Yuuna Yamashita
source:
A close friend of Sandra and Leona from college, and the mother of Yui and Natsumi. As a single mother she's been preoccupied with keeping her family's livelihood stable, leaving her little time to watch her children or to go out drinking with Sandra and Leona like she used to.

[In game description]
